# Project Rules
- Use modern HTML5 and CSS3 (Flexbox/Grid).
- All pages must have a consistent look and feel.
- Use a common navigation bar (Navbar) on every page.
- Primary colors: #0984e3 (blue) and #2d3436 (dark grey).
- Implement a Dark/Light theme toggle using CSS variables.
- Ensure the design is responsive (works on mobile).
- For the team page, use a clean card layout for each member.
